title: No winner of major lotto games on Sunday as Ultra Lotto jackpot reaches P410 million
summary: There were no winners of either of the major lotto games played on Sunday, October 18, 2026, with one jackpot now well over P400 million.

blocks.text: There were no winners of either of the major lotto games played by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office on Sunday, October 18, 2026, with one jackpot now well over P400 million.
No bettor chose the winning combination of 54-19-52-35-17-24 for the Ultra Lotto 6/58 game, with the prize now at P410,973,545.48.
There were also no winners of the Superlotto 6/49 jackpot of P54,626,649.78, with the winning number combination of 37-36-20-23-48-26.
